_comment: Special conditions that have NO public hostname and are never part of the deployable handler. Google /sorry/ is a protocol-level fixture only (the exact URL, status and body text a classifier receives); no owned page imitates it and no browser visits it. Proxy failures are browser-transport fixtures produced by a local gateway; Chromium shows them at chrome-error://chromewebdata/. The YouTube account gate is a normal lane: /scenario/youtube-account-gate/{token} on the parent origin.

googleRateLimit.text: Our systems have detected unusual traffic from your computer network.

youtubeGate.text: Sign in to confirm you're not a bot

proxy_auth_407.description: HTTPS through a gateway that answers every CONNECT with 407 Proxy Authentication Required (credentials are never supplied). Chromium shows "HTTP ERROR 407".

http_502.description: Plain HTTP through a gateway that answers 502 with an empty body. Chromium shows "HTTP ERROR 502".

tunnel_502.description: HTTPS through a gateway that answers CONNECT with 502. Chromium reports a tunnel failure, NOT "HTTP ERROR 502".

proxy_unreachable.description: Browser is pointed at a loopback proxy port with nothing listening.

proxyGateway.note: expectedVerdict is what ChallengeClassifier.classify(url=chrome-error://chromewebdata/, page_text=<error page text>) returns; expectedMarker is proxy_transport_marker(url, page_text, error_text). Chromium also opens its own background CONNECTs (observed: www.google.com:443) inside a proxied context; they reach only the loopback gateway, which never forwards anything.
